convergence.comparison: pixelmatch threshold 0.1 (the Gate-1 harness parameter), pen interactive Export scale 2 vs Playwright deviceScaleFactor-2 clipped captures of the NORMALIZED prototype at the .pen frame dimensions. Chromium 151.0.7922.34 headless-shell launched with --disable-lcd-text: grayscale text antialiasing aligned to the pen rasterizer's AA model. Protocol context: rounds 1-5 compared against default-flag Chromium (LCD subpixel AA); the round-6 evidence bundle proved the entire over-threshold residual on the six plateaued text-dense states was LCD chroma fringing (grayscale re-render of the SAME unmodified exports: 1.007-1.174% -> 0.889-0.918%), i.e. rasterizer AA configuration, not geometry/color/content. The alignment changes only the measurement's noise floor - the .pen, the token mapping, and the 1.0% threshold are untouched, and sensitivity to real deltas increases. Full protocol: reducedMotion:reduce, animation/transition freeze CSS, document.fonts.ready, states.json step drive, 2500ms deferred-timer settle, pointer parked at 0,0, capture root snapped to integer CSS coordinates via fractional translate, integer clip at frame dimensions.

normalizationRecipe.fontSwap: No family substitution required — the prototype already leads with Heebo (--font-ui) and Noto Serif (--font-serif). Serving source pinned: the Google Fonts stylesheet link is replaced by @font-face rules for the SAME repo TTFs the .pen embeds (pencil/designs/fonts/). Plus: .btn-primary, .segmented button, input, textarea, select gain font-family var(--font-ui) — these controls set no font-family and rendered UA Arial (prototype defect, flagged).
normalizationRecipe.captureProtocol: drive.js v2.1 (freeze CSS, pointer parking, geometry quiescence, self-consistent shots) + reducedMotion:reduce + 2500ms deferred-timer settle + capture-root snapped to integer CSS coordinates via fractional translate (recorded per state; body-mounted dialogs land at sub-pixel offsets)
normalizationRecipe.notes: Unrendered-in-contracted-states variables were injected for kit coherence but never measured: --seq*, --pos-mid, --pos-soft/--neg-soft, --accent-fill, --crosshair-stroke (legacy), --taupe-hover (hover-only), --orange, --charcoal, --hairline, pros/cons/info washes, --gauge-*, --cat1..15 (undashed template set), --hero-*, watchlist freight (#cs-watchlist scope, flags D2). REPLAY MECHANICS (verified this dispatch - the recipe replays mechanically): the injected <style> block must land at the LAST </body> occurrence (the prototype embeds an earlier '</body>' inside a JS string); the control font swap (.btn-primary, .segmented button, input, textarea, select -> var(--font-ui)) and the UA-chrome dialog-button colors need !important to beat the prototype's higher-specificity control rules. Without the font swap applying, the entry inputs render UA Arial at 36px instead of Heebo at 41px and every page-1/2/3 frame height shifts 5.5-9.75px.
